description: Quantum atomic structure decomposed. Schrodinger equation, quantum numbers, orbital shapes, Hund's rule, Pauli exclusion, term symbols, spin-orbit coupling, atomic spectra, ionization energies.

sub_mechanisms.name: schrodinger_atomic
sub_mechanisms.definition: Hψ = Eψ. Time-independent. Exact for H atom; numerical for multi-electron.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of quantum chemistry. ψ² gives probability density. Energy quantised by boundary conditions.

sub_mechanisms.name: principal_quantum_number_n
sub_mechanisms.definition: n = 1, 2, 3... Determines energy + size of orbital.
sub_mechanisms.why: Energy levels: E = -13.6/n² eV for H. Shell number. Foundation.

sub_mechanisms.name: angular_momentum_l
sub_mechanisms.definition: l = 0 to n-1. Determines orbital shape: s (0), p (1), d (2), f (3).
sub_mechanisms.why: Subshell. s spherical, p dumbbell, d cloverleaf. Foundation of orbital geometry.

sub_mechanisms.name: magnetic_ml_quantum
sub_mechanisms.definition: ml = -l to +l. Determines orbital orientation. p_x, p_y, p_z.
sub_mechanisms.why: Spatial degeneracy. 3 p orbitals, 5 d orbitals. Foundation of bonding directionality.

sub_mechanisms.name: spin_ms
sub_mechanisms.why: Pauli exclusion: each orbital max 2 electrons (opposite spin). Foundation of multi-electron atoms.

sub_mechanisms.name: Hund_rule
sub_mechanisms.definition: Maximum multiplicity. Electrons fill degenerate orbitals singly before pairing.
sub_mechanisms.why: Predicts ground state. Carbon: 2 unpaired in 2p (not paired). Affects magnetic + spectral properties.

sub_mechanisms.name: Pauli_exclusion
sub_mechanisms.definition: No two electrons in same atom can have all four quantum numbers identical.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation. Without: all electrons in 1s. Periodic table consequence. Determines chemistry.

sub_mechanisms.name: shielding_effective_Z
sub_mechanisms.definition: Inner electrons shield outer from nucleus. Z_eff < Z.
sub_mechanisms.why: Slater's rules estimate. Explains periodic trends: across row Z_eff increases → atoms smaller.

sub_mechanisms.name: ionization_energy
sub_mechanisms.definition: Energy to remove electron. First IE removes loosest. Increases across row, decreases down.
sub_mechanisms.why: Periodic property. Noble gases highest (stable). Alkali metals lowest (lose easily). Reactivity predictor.

sub_mechanisms.name: electron_affinity
sub_mechanisms.definition: Energy released on electron capture. Halogens most exothermic.
sub_mechanisms.why: Predicts ion formation. F + e⁻ → F⁻ releases ~328 kJ/mol. Foundation of ionic bonding.

sub_mechanisms.name: electronegativity_Pauling
sub_mechanisms.definition: Atom's electron-pulling power in bond. F = 4.0 (max), Cs = 0.7.
sub_mechanisms.why: Predicts bond polarity. Difference > 1.7: ionic. < 0.4: nonpolar covalent. Standard tool.

sub_mechanisms.name: atomic_spectra_emission
sub_mechanisms.definition: Transitions emit photons. ΔE = hν. Each element has unique fingerprint spectrum.
sub_mechanisms.why: Hydrogen Balmer (visible), Lyman (UV), Paschen (IR). Element ID from spectra. Foundation of astronomy + analytical chem.

derivation_rules.name: quantum_numbers_completely_specify_electron
derivation_rules.why: n, l, ml, ms unique per electron (Pauli). Determines energy + spatial distribution + spin. Foundation.

derivation_rules.name: electronegativity_difference_predicts_bond_type
derivation_rules.why: 0.4-1.7 polar covalent; < 0.4 nonpolar. NaCl ΔEN=2.1 ionic. CH4 ΔEN=0.4 nonpolar. Universal predictor.

derivation_rules.name: ionization_periodic_across_row
if: element moves left to right in periodic table
derivation_rules.why: Z_eff increases; size shrinks; harder to remove electron. Exceptions at p-orbital half-filling (Hund stability).

derivation_rules.name: Hund_rule_minimum_energy_configuration
then: each orbital singly first, then pair
derivation_rules.why: Minimises electron repulsion. C: 2s²2p² has 2 unpaired in different p orbitals. Standard ground state prediction.

derivation_rules.name: spectroscopy_fingerprints_elements
derivation_rules.why: Each element has characteristic line spectrum from quantised transitions. Foundation of analytical spectroscopy, helium discovered in Sun's spectrum.
